name: Locked in the Trunk of a Car

podcast.body: Released as the first single from *Fully Completely*, this song had been frequently performed live under the working title "Dump in the Body" right up until about a week before the band went to England to record the album. Producer Chris Sangerides specifically encouraged guitarist Paul Langlois to contribute more background vocals to this track, recognizing his "unusual" voice as a unique asset that subtly but significantly enhanced the arrangement. "Locked in the Trunk of a Car, the first single from fully completely."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song from "Fully Completely" draws its inspiration from the 1970 kidnapping and murder of Quebec deputy premier Pierre Laporte during the FLQ crisis. A live recording of this song from March 18, 1993, at the Lansdown Hotel in Sydney, Australia, is noted. "And locked in the trunk of a car goes back to 1970, the kidnapping and murder of Quebec deputy premier Pierre La Port during the FLQ crisis."
